name: Finding A Job
overview: Scripture teaches that finding a job involves trusting in the Lord and doing good, as this leads to provision and stability (Psalms 37:3). Believers are encouraged to acknowledge God in all their ways so that He may direct their paths (Proverbs 3:6) and to commit wholeheartedly to their work, recognizing its temporal nature (Ecclesiastes 9:10). God promises to establish the work of our hands (Psalms 90:17) and assures us of His good plans for our future (Jeremiah 29:11). Prayer with faith is essential, trusting that God will provide according to His will (Mark 11:24).
